text: You knocked a junior analyst out at her desk, in front of the whole floor. So I tidied. Not well enough, it seems.
style: SAFETYNET's cryptographic-hardware analyst. Consistent British Received Pronunciation accent throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Calm, precise, technically fluent; a colleague you trust. Tonight he is the mole, unmasked, across an interrogation table from an agent he taught, with nothing left to lose and no intention of apologising: rueful, articulate and completely unrepentant -- he argues his case like a man who has rehearsed it alone for years.
